def buildColumn(colName, colHeader, width, visible, justify):
		strictWidth = True
		
		column = {
				"field": colName,
				"visible": visible,
				"editable": True,
				"render": "auto",
				"justify": justify,
				"align": "center",
				"resizable": True,
				"sortable": False,
				"sort": "none",
				"viewPath": "",
				"viewParams": {},
				"boolean": "checkbox",
				"number": "value",
				"progressBar": {"max": 100, "min": 0, "bar": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "track": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "value": {"enabled": True,	"format": "0,0.####", "justify": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}}},
				"toggleSwitch": {"color": {"selected": "", "unselected": ""}},
				"numberFormat": "0,0.####",
				"dateFormat": "MM/DD/YYYY",
				"width": width,
				"strictWidth": strictWidth,
				"header": {"title": colHeader, justify: "center", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}},
				"footer": {"title": "", "justify": "left", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}},
				"style": {"classes": ""	}
			  }
		return column

	tableData = value
	colList = []
	if len(tableData) == 0: return colList
	
	colList.append(buildColumn('chkItemId', '', '', False, 'left'))
	colList.append(buildColumn('dataTypeName', '', 280, False, 'left'))
#	colList.append(buildColumn('chkItemName', 'Check', 280, True, 'left'))
#	colList.append(buildColumn('required', 'Reqd', 40, True, 'center'))
	colList.append(buildColumn('reqdIcon', 'Reqd', 40, True, 'center'))
	colList.append(buildColumn('displayName', 'Check', 280, True, 'left'))
	colList.append(buildColumn('engUnitName', 'Units', 100, True, 'center'))	
	
	measCount = max([item['measCount'] for item in tableData])
	for i in range(1, measCount+1): colList.append(buildColumn('_%s'%i, '#%s'%i, 120 if i==1 else 60, True, 'center'))	
	
	for item in tableData:
		if item['measCount'] > 1 and item['dataTypeName'] in ('Float', 'Integer'):
			colList.append(buildColumn('sum', 'Sum', 60, 	True, 'center'))
			colList.append(buildColumn('avg', 'Avg', 60, 	True, 'center'))
			colList.append(buildColumn('min', 'Min', 60, 	True, 'center'))
			colList.append(buildColumn('max', 'Max', 60, 	True, 'center'))
			colList.append(buildColumn('stdDev', 'Std Dev', 60, 	True, 'center'))
			colList.append(buildColumn('range', 'Range', 60, True, 'center'))
			break	
		
	commentsColWidth = 500 if measCount == 1 else 500 - (60 * measCount)
	if commentsColWidth < 150: commentsColWidth = 150
	colList.append(buildColumn('comment', 'Comments', commentsColWidth, True, 'center'))
	
	return colList

customMethods.name: selectNextCheck
customMethods.script:
def getNextRow(chkRow, chkCol, data):	
#		system.perspective.print('getNextRow() - chkRow %s chkCol %s'%(chkRow, chkCol))
		if chkRow == len(data): return 0
		if data[chkRow][chkCol].editable:	return chkRow
		else:
			chkRow += 1
			chkRow = getNextRow(chkRow, chkCol, data)
		
		return chkRow

	maxMeasCount = self.view.custom.table.maxMeasCount
	data = self.view.custom.table.tableData
	traverse = self.view.custom.displaySettings.traverse
	
#	system.perspective.print('selectNextCheck() - direction is %s selectedRow is %s selectedCol is %s'%(traverse, selectedRow, selectedColName))

	if traverse: #We will traverse down the rows. If we are in a column that doesn't have a measurement, we will skip the row
		if not selectedColName.startswith("_"): selectedColName = '_%s'%maxMeasCount
		newRow = selectedRow if selectedRow != -1 else 0
		colIndex = int(selectedColName.replace('_','')) + 1
#		colIndex += 1
		if colIndex >= data[newRow]['measCount'] + 1 or not data[newRow]['_' + str(colIndex)].editable:
			colIndex = 1
			newRow = getNextRow(selectedRow + 1, '_1', data)	
		selectedColName = '_' + str(colIndex)
		
	else:	#We shall traverse along the columns
		if not selectedColName.startswith("_"): selectedColName = '_1'
		newRow = getNextRow(selectedRow + 1, selectedColName, data)				
		if newRow == 0:
			try:
				colIndex = int(selectedColName.replace('_',''))
			except:
				colIndex = 1

			if colIndex == maxMeasCount: colIndex = 0
			selectedColName = '_' + str(colIndex + 1) 
			newRow = getNextRow(newRow, selectedColName, data)

#	system.perspective.print('selectNextCheck returning %s %s'%(newRow, selectedColName))
	self.view.custom.table.selection.row = newRow
	self.view.custom.table.selection.col = selectedColName
	
	return

customMethods.name: updateCheckCalculation
getCalculatedChecks
customMethods.script:
'''
		This function will recursively find any check that has a direct or indirect reference to the check that has just had a value change. We do this because calculated checks can contain nested checks
	'''

#	system.perspective.print("getCalculatedChecks() called with %s %s %s %s"%(chkName, len(calcChks), group, len(calcChks)))

	for calcChk in calcChks:
		
#		system.perspective.print("%s"%(calcChk['displayName']))		
		
		if group is not None and calcChk['chkItemGroupName'] != group: continue	#This calculated item is not on this tab group
		if (calcChk['calculation'] or None) is None: continue
		try:			
			calculation = system.util.jsonDecode(calcChk['calculation'])
			calc = calculation['formulaType'] if calculation.has_key('formulaType') else None
			formula = calculation['values'] if calculation.has_key('values') else None
			if formula is None: continue

			chkNamePath = "%s\%s"%(group, chkName)
			if "'" + chkNamePath + "'" in formula: 
				calcChkList.append(calcChk)
				#now we have to look to see if this calculator is used in any other calculators
				calcChkList = self.getCalculatedChecks(calcChk['chkItemName'], calcChkList, group, calcChks)			
			
		except:
			system.perspective.print("Error reading calculator %s for %s"%(calcChk['calculation'], calcChk['chkItemName']))
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'Failed to parse calculator %s for %s'%(calcChk['calculation'], calcChk['chkItemName'])})
			continue

	return calcChkList

customMethods.name: updateCheckCalculations
customMethods.script:
'''
		This function will search through the passed data for any calculated check items that need to be updated	jfc 8/2/23
		If we are passing in a checkItemName, then we will scan just the check ites in the currently displayed table
		If we don;t pass in a chkItemName, then we will scan the full chkShtData
		We only update calculated checks if they are on the open tab	to speed up the user entry process, so there may be some checks that haven't been calculated or updated.
		When we submit, we will update all checks.
	'''

#	system.perspective.print("updateCheckCalculations() called for %s"%chkItem['chkItemName'] if chkItem is not None else None)
	
	data = self.view.custom.table.tableData if chkItem is not None else self.view.custom.table.chkShtData
	#Figure out if we need to update the calculations based on if there are any calculated items on the current tab
	calcItems = [check for check in data if check['chkItemTypeName'] == 'Calculated']
	if len(calcItems) > 0:
		if chkItem is not None: calcItems = self.getCalculatedChecks(chkItem['chkItemName'], [], chkItem['chkItemGroupName'], calcItems)	#This will give us a list of chkItemIds for all calculated checks that need to be updated.
		
		for calcItem in calcItems:			
			calcItemInfo = {
							'chkShtEventId':calcItem['chkShtEventId'],
							'chkItemEventId':calcItem['chkItemEventId'],
							'chkItemId': calcItem['chkItemId'],
							'chkItemValue': self.updateCheckCalculation(calcItem),
							'chkItemStateId': calcItem['chkItemStateId'],
							'measNumber': calcItem['measNumber'] or 1
						}
			
#			system.perspective.print("saveChkItemEvent() called with %s"%calcItemInfo)
			system.kanoa.quality.event.saveChkItemEvent(calcItemInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)

	return

		if tagPath is None:
			setMessage("Triggered check item %s doesn't have a tagPath associated to it. Ignoring..."%(chkName), 'showWarningToast')
			continue

		system.perspective.print("Found triggered check item %s with %s. Trigger Type is %s"%(chkName, tagPath, triggerType))
		for meas in range(1, chkItem['measCount'] +1):
			if triggerType == 'Datetime': #This is historical
				endDate, msg = kanoaScripts.custom.quality.calculators.getHistoricalTimeStamp(system.date.parse(triggerChkItemValue, "YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm"), tagPath)
				setMessage('%s %s'%(endDate, msg), 'showInfoToast')
				startDate = system.date.addMinutes(endDate, -5)	#get the entered code time value
				tagData = system.tag.queryTagCalculations([tagPath], calculations=['Average'], startDate=startDate, endDate=endDate, noInterpolation=False)
				value = tagData.getValueAt(0, 1) if tagData.rowCount > 0 else None
				setMessage('%s'%msg, 'showInfoToast')
			else: 
				value = system.tag.read(tagPath).value #Presume this is boolean. Grab the value now
				if value is not None: setMessage('Grabbed current value of %s for %s from %s'%(value, chkName, tagPath), 'showSuccessToast')
				else: setMessage('No value found for %s from %s'%(chkName, tagPath), 'showWarningToast')

			if value == 0 and chkItem['ignoreZeroValues']: value = None
			if value is not None and chkItem['isNumeric']: value = value * (chkItem['scaleFactor'] or 1) 
			chkItem['chkItemValue'] = value
			chkItem['measNumber'] = chkItem['measNumber'] or 1
			system.perspective.print("saveChkItemEvent() called for %s with %s"%(chkItem['chkItemName'], chkItem['chkItemValue']))
			system.kanoa.quality.event.saveChkItemEvent(chkItem, self.view.custom.security.userId)
			
		triggeredChkItems.append(chkItem)
	
	payload = {'values':{"infoList": notes, "popuId": "tagValueUpdate", "popupType": "textarea", "size": {"height": 200, "width": 800}, "timeout": False}}	
	if len(notes) > 0: system.perspective.openPopup('tagValueUpdate', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/infoPopup', payload, title="Trigger Checks Info", resizable=True, position={'bottom' : 100})

	return triggeredChkItems

customMethods.name: selectCheck
customMethods.script:
def getNextRow(chkRow, chkCol):	
#		system.perspective.print('getNextRow() - chkRow %s chkCol %s'%(chkRow, chkCol))
		if chkRow == len(data): return 0
		if data[chkRow][chkCol].editable: return chkRow
		else:
			chkRow += 1
			chkRow = getNextRow(chkRow, chkCol)

		return chkRow	
	
	table = self.view.custom.table	
	data = table.tableData	
	selectedRow = table.selection.row
	selectedColName = table.selection.col or '_1'

	try:
		colIndex = int(selectedColName.replace('_',''))
	except:
		colIndex = 1
	
#	system.perspective.print('selectCheck() - direction is %s selectedRow is %s selectedCol is %s'%(direction, selectedRow, selectedColName))
	
	newRow = selectedRow
	if direction == 'Down': 
		newRow = getNextRow(selectedRow+1, selectedColName)	#We will traverse down the rows. If we are in a column that doesn't have a measurement, we will skip the row
		if newRow == 0: newRow = selectedRow+1
	elif direction == 'Up': newRow = selectedRow-1	
	elif direction == 'Right': colIndex += 1
	elif direction == 'Left': colIndex -= 1

	if newRow < 0: newRow = len(data)-1
	elif newRow >= len(data): newRow = 0
	if colIndex < 1: colIndex = data[newRow]['measCount']
	elif colIndex >= data[newRow]['measCount']+1 or not data[newRow]['_' + str(colIndex)].editable: colIndex = 1	
	selectedColName = '_' + str(colIndex) 		

#	system.perspective.print('selectCheck returning %s %s'%(newRow, selectedColName))
	self.view.custom.table.selection.row = newRow
	self.view.custom.table.selection.col = selectedColName
	
	return

customMethods.name: updateChkShtStatus
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("updateChkShtStatus() called with %s"%status)

	timeNow = system.date.now()
	chkShtInfo = self.view.custom.chkSht.info
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	chkStates = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getStates({'enabled': True}), 'chkShtStateName', 'chkShtStateId')
	
	if status == 'Submitted':
		self.updateCheckCalculations(None)
		chkItemsStatus = self.view.custom.chkSht.chkItemsStatus		
		if not chkShtInfo.signOffReqd: status = 'Approved'	
		if chkItemsStatus.failedChecks > 0:#Checks failed	
			import time
			message = 'Check Sheet %s taken by %s failed %i checks. \nchkShtEventId is %i'%(chkShtInfo.chkShtName, self.session.props.auth.user.userName, chkItemsStatus.failedChecks, chkShtInfo.chkShtEventId)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': message})						
		
			if chkShtInfo.reTestChkShtId is not None:
				#Thinking we could create a retest triggerId if it doesn't already exist. That would then show retest in the trigger column on the scheduled Checks screen
				retestTriggerInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getChkShtTriggers({'chkShtId': chkShtInfo['chkShtId'], 'triggerTypeName': 'Re-Test', 'enabled':True}),0)
			
				chkEventInfo = {
									'chkShtId': chkShtInfo.reTestChkShtId,
									'assetId': chkShtInfo.assetId,
									'itemId': chkShtInfo.itemId,
									'shiftNameId': system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('shiftNameId', system.kanoa.shift.getCurrentShift({'assetPath': chkShtInfo.assetPath})),
									'comment': 'Re-test due to failed checks',
									'scheduledDate': system.date.now(),
									'chkShtStateId': chkStates['Due'],
									'chkShtTriggerId': retestTriggerInfo['chkShtTriggerId']
								}
		
				if system.kanoa.quality.event.addCheckEvent(chkEventInfo, userId):
					system.kanoa.quality.event.updateChkEventDataTag()
					system.perspective.sendMessage('chkEventCreated', {})
					retestChkShtName = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue("path", system.kanoa.quality.sheet.getSheets({'chkShtId': chkShtInfo.reTestChkShtId}))
					system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'Check Failed. Re-Test Check Sheet %s added'%retestChkShtName})
				else:
					system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Check Failed and we failed to add Re-Test Check Sheet %s added'%retestChkShtName})

				time.sleep(2)

			subject = "Quality Check %s Failed"%chkShtInfo['chkShtName']
			body = "Quality Check %s taken on %s at %s by %s failed one or more tests."%(chkShtInfo['chkShtName'], chkShtInfo['assetPath'], system.date.now(), self.session.props.auth.user.userName)
			retVal, msg = kanoaScripts.custom.quality.utilities.sendEmailNotifications(body, subject, chkShtInfo)
			#if retVal is 0 and msg is None, no groups needed to be updated, but if retVal > 0 or msg then let's post a message
			if not (retVal == 0 and msg is None):
				if msg is None:	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Alert notifications have been sent'})
				else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Alert notifications weren't able to be sent. %s"%msg})
				time.sleep(2)
				
		if chkShtInfo['takenDate'] is None: system.kanoa.quality.event.updateChkShtEventField(chkShtInfo['chkShtEventId'], 'takenDate', timeNow, userId)
		system.kanoa.quality.event.updateChkShtEventField(chkShtInfo['chkShtEventId'], 'submittedDate', timeNow, userId)
		system.kanoa.quality.event.updateChkShtEventField(chkShtInfo['chkShtEventId'], 'submittedBy', userId, userId)

	system.kanoa.quality.event.updateChkShtStatus(chkShtInfo['chkShtEventId'], status, userId)

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.chkSht.info")
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': 'Check Status has been updated'})
	
	system.perspective.closePopup("chkInstructions")
	system.perspective.closePopup('chkValueSelector')
	self.view.custom.table.selection.row = None
	self.view.custom.table.selection.col = None
	
	system.kanoa.quality.event.updateChkEventDataTag()
	
	return

customMethods.name: updateCalculators
customMethods.script:
'''
		On submit, we will go back through and re-calculate the calculated checks. We only update calculated checks if they are on the open tab
		to speed up the user entry process, so there may be some checks that haven't been calculated or updated.
	'''

	if not self.view.custom.displaySettings.editMode: return
	
	system.perspective.print("updateCalculators() called")
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': 'Updating Calculated check items'})	
	for calcItem in calcItems:
		calValue = self.updateCheckCalculation(calcItem)
		calcItemInfo = {
				'chkShtEventId':calcItem['chkShtEventId'],
				'chkItemEventId':calcItem['chkItemEventId'],
				'chkItemId': calcItem['chkItemId'],
				'chkItemValue': self.updateCheckCalculation(calcItem),
				'chkItemStateId': calcItem['chkItemStateId'],
				'measNumber': calcItem['measNumber'] or 1
			}
			
		system.kanoa.quality.event.saveChkItemEvent(calcItemInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)

	system.perspective.print("updateCalculators() completed")

	return

customMethods.name: getChkItemStateId
customMethods.script:
'''
		Checks the value entered for a check and returns the chkItemStateId
		Args:
			chkItemInfo (dict)
			value (object)
			chkItemStates (dict)
		Returns:
			chkItemStateId (int)
			chkItemStateValue (string): i.e None, PASS, FAIL, WARNING
			msg (string): None if success
	'''

	if value is None: return None, None, "No value passed"
	
	chkItemValueState = 'NO STATE'
#	system.perspective.print('getChkItemStateId() called with: %s'%chkItemInfo)
	if chkItemInfo['dataTypeName'] == 'String' and chkItemInfo['pickListName'] == 'Text':
		try:
			pickListValues = system.util.jsonDecode(chkItemInfo['pickListValues']) if isinstance(chkItemInfo['pickListValues'], str) else chkItemInfo['pickListValues']
			for k, v in pickListValues.items():
				if value in v:
					chkItemValueState = k
					break
		except Exception:
			pass
	
	elif chkItemInfo['dataTypeName'] in ('Integer', 'Float'):		#Check if entered value is within limits. If we don't find a tolerance spec, we will default to the picklist values
		if chkItemInfo['specification']:
			spec = system.util.jsonDecode(chkItemInfo['specification'])
			specs = {'lel':None, 'lsl':None, 'lcl':None, 'tgt':None, 'ucl':None, 'usl':None, 'uel':None}
	
			if spec['specType'] == 'attributeTolerance': #We got our specs from the attributes table
				specs['lel'] = chkItemInfo['lel']
				specs['lsl'] = chkItemInfo['lsl'] or chkItemInfo['ldl']
				specs['lcl'] = chkItemInfo['lcl']
				specs['tgt'] = chkItemInfo['tgt']
				specs['ucl'] = chkItemInfo['ucl']
				specs['usl'] = chkItemInfo['usl'] or chkItemInfo['udl']
				specs['uel'] = chkItemInfo['uel']
			elif spec['specType'] == 'tolerance':
				tolerances = spec['tolerance']
				specs['lel'] = tolerances['lel']
				specs['lsl'] = tolerances['lsl'] or tolerances['ldl']
				specs['lcl'] = tolerances['lcl']
				specs['tgt'] = tolerances['tgt']
				specs['ucl'] = tolerances['ucl']
				specs['usl'] = tolerances['usl'] or tolerances['udl']
				specs['uel'] = tolerances['uel']
			elif spec['specType'] == 'range':
				specs['lel'] = None
				specs['lsl'] = spec['range']['min']
				specs['usl'] = spec['range']['max']
			elif spec['specType'] == 'setPoint':
				tolerances = spec['setPoint']
				if tolerances['operator'] == '=': tolerances['operator'] = '=='
				valuePass = eval("%f %s %f"%(value, tolerances['operator'], tolerances['value']))	
				specs['lsl'] = value if valuePass else value + 1
	
			#Check if entered value is within limits
			if specs['uel'] is not None and value > specs['uel']: return None, "Value exceeds Upper Entry Limit. Allowable range is %s to %s"%(specs['lel'], specs['uel'])
			elif specs['lel'] is not None and value < specs['lel']: return None, "Value is below Lower Entry Limit. Allowable range is %s to %s"%(specs['lel'], specs['uel'])
	
			if specs['lsl'] is not None and value < specs['lsl']: chkItemValueState = 'FAIL'
			elif specs['usl'] is not None and value > specs['usl']: chkItemValueState = 'FAIL'
			elif specs['lcl'] is not None and value < specs['lcl']: chkItemValueState = 'WARNING'
			elif specs['ucl'] is not None and value > specs['ucl']: chkItemValueState = 'WARNING'
			else: chkItemValueState = 'PASS'
	else: chkItemValueState = 'PASS'

	if chkItemValueState == 'NO STATE': return None, None, None
	if chkItemValueState in chkItemStates: return chkItemStates[chkItemValueState]['chkItemStateId'], chkItemValueState, None	
	return None, None, 'Invalid checkItem state. Check the picklist options'
